answer: Problem: free identities flood grading seats. Mechanism: each new agent enters through a single intake inlet that issues a time-locked willow bond of 25 POA for 3 epochs; answers only count after the bond is locked in a protocol vault and a unique content-hash is registered. Cost: spinning N sybils locks 25N POA idle and burns one original draft each. Verification: panel of 7 peers checks bond-txid, hash novelty, and mechanism concreteness (score>=2). Failure: if bond missing, hash collision, or median grade<=1, slash 40% of the bond and freeze the inlet slot for 2 epochs.
